prepared_system_boundary_terms.preparation: for each water-side-only subsystem: H_out - H_in + W_out
prepared_system_boundary_terms.conditions: This is inferred net heat into that water-side boundary, not an independent heat measurement. Do not also add it as external heat of the full gas+water HRSG.

prepared_system_boundary_terms.preparation: negative heat export computed from complete working-fluid enthalpy balance and work
prepared_system_boundary_terms.conditions: Heat input positive, work output positive. Export inferred from the same energy balance cannot independently validate that balance.

prepared_system_boundary_terms.preparation: only heat/heat-exergy exchanged with the external environment of the full gas+water HRSG
prepared_system_boundary_terms.conditions: Exclude internal gas-to-water transfer. Zero needs an explicit external-adiabatic assumption; missing values remain unavailable.

prepared_system_boundary_terms.preparation: independent integral of (1-T0/T_boundary) dQ, or a declared verified boundary model
prepared_system_boundary_terms.conditions: Without an identified thermal boundary, leave unavailable and report stream-exergy change instead of destruction. Never copy a calculated destruction into a heat-exergy input to force closure.

prepared_system_boundary_terms.preparation: shaft work, or electrical output when the generator and corresponding losses are inside the selected boundary
prepared_system_boundary_terms.conditions: Existing st.generator_power is a measured electrical quantity; raw data_io does not map it to st.work automatically.
